curation.notes: Custom dual-trap optical tweezers test a rationally designed DNA catch bond ('fish-hook'): a hook construct (2633 bp dsDNA handle + PEG spacer + ssDNA hook) and a fish construct (272 bp handle + jaw/hook-binding region) on separate 1 µm streptavidin beads are brought into contact and retracted at three speeds; rupture forces/ΔLc fitted by XWLC and compared with analytical and Monte Carlo models. No AFM is used (auto record was wrong).

evidence.snippet: All optical trap experiments were performed at room temperature (~23 °C).
Data is collected at 5000 Hz using custom LabVIEW code.
The fish and hook DNA constructs were attached separately to 1 µm diameter streptavidin-coated polystyrene beads (Bang Labs, Fishers, IN, USA)

handle_sequences.annotations: The final hook construct was 2633 bp of double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) with a PEG spacer connecting the single-stranded hook on one 5′ end and a biotin on the other 5′ end.
The final fish construct was 272 bp of dsDNA with biotin on one 5′ end and the fish on the other end.

entities.name: DNA fish-hook catch bond (ssDNA hook hybridised to fish jaw/hook-binding region)

evidence.snippet: The fish was created separately from two single-stranded sequences: one containing the hook binding region and one of the jaw strands, and the other containing the complementary jaw strand and a sticky end for ligation to the handle.

entities.name: Hook handle (2633 bp lambda-DNA PCR product, PEG spacer, 5′ biotin)

evidence.snippet: The hook handle was a 2633 bp PCR-amplified segment of a lambda DNA template (New England Biolabs, Whitby, ON, Canada).

entities.name: Fish handle (272 bp lambda-DNA PCR product, 5′ biotin)

evidence.snippet: The fish handle was 272 bp of dsDNA, similarly constructed from the lambda template with a reverse primer modified with 5′ biotin.

The trap buffer used in all the optical trap experiments contains 50 mM NaCl, 10 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), 5 mM MgCl2, and an oxygen scavenger system using 20 mM protocatechuic acid (PCA) and 50 nM protocatechuate-3,4-dioxygenase
